status_note: Statements and evidence are those in config/phases.json. Thresholds that read 'proposed default' there are frozen here at those values. The sample sizes and the confidence level are added here, because the statements did not give them. D2 has not started: it needs hardware the owner has not approved buying, and a dated owner approval to connect it.
authorization: Motors disarmed and propellers removed throughout. Connecting to the flight controller and any link-cut test each need a dated owner approval (AGENTS.md section 2.3). No arming.
pass_rule: Every trial in a test must meet its threshold. A hand-carried pass is not flight qualification.

measures.camera_imu_offset: estimate with a 95% confidence interval, from at least 3 sessions
measures.frame_consistency: pass/fail: the frame check passes in every session
measures.end_to_end_latency: distribution reported: median, p99 and worst

ET-D2-1.threshold: offset estimate with a 95% CI; frame check passes in 3/3 sessions; latency distribution reported

ET-D2-2.inconclusive: If the reference does not pass ET-D2-3, this test is inconclusive, not a pass.

ET-D2-3.inconclusive: Inadequate coverage is inconclusive, not a pass.

threshold.freshness_gate_stops_sending: in every trial, independently of the laptop

ET-D2-4.note: PX4 selects no action while disarmed, so the action itself is tested in ET-D4-4.

ET-D2-5.note: The statement names the Pixhawk 6X. If the owner approves the ARKV6X line instead, this statement changes by a dated owner approval before any result exists.

required_in_the_d2_report.note: Open items from earlier reports that need real hardware. Each is reported with its evidence. None is a threshold, and none moves a pass to a fail by itself.
